text: Hey all, quick question—does anyone know if you can take PTO during your first week after an internal transfer? I’m moving to the Ops team next Monday and had already planned a couple days off. Not sure if that’s allowed or if I need to wait.

Hi Sam! Good question. So, it’s not in the handbook yet, but our current practice is that you need your new manager’s written approval for PTO during your first two weeks in a new role after an internal transfer. There’s a short form your new manager has to sign off on—just ping them and then send the approval to HR. Let me know if you need the form link!
Thanks Priya! That’s super helpful. I’ll reach out to my new manager and get that sorted. If you could DM me the form, that’d be great.
Will do, Sam! Sending it your way now. Just shout if you have any other questions.
